snapshot.what_it_does: ITC Limited is a public limited company domiciled in India, listed on the NSE and BSE, and is a diversified conglomerate. Its businesses span Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (Cigarettes & Cigars, Foods, Personal Care Products, Education & Stationery Products, Safety Matches and Agarbattis), Paperboards, Paper and Packaging, and Agri Business.

key_facts: Standalone profit before tax from continuing operations of ₹26,767.60 crores for FY2026 (p162)
Consolidated profit before tax from continuing operations of ₹28,033.39 crores for FY2026 (p258)
Consolidated net cash from operating activities of ₹18,464.31 crores for FY2026 (p258)
Hotels business was demerged via a Scheme of Demerger in FY2025, with a gain on fair valuation of net assets of ₹15,583.12 crores (consolidated) (p258)
Consolidated capex (purchase of PP&E, intangibles, ROU assets) of ₹2,182.89 crores in FY2026 (p258)

bull.point: FY2026 continuing operations remained highly profitable: consolidated PBT ₹28,033.39cr and standalone PBT ₹26,767.60cr.
FY2026 operating cash flow ₹18,464.31cr covered capex ₹2,182.89cr about 8.5x, indicating strong internal funding capacity.
Revenue momentum is strong: quarter ended 2026-06-30 revenue ₹29,523.30cr, +27.6% YoY, after 2026-03-31 ₹23,821.48cr, +16.9% YoY.

bear.point: Latest quarter shows severe compression: EBITDA margin 17.3% versus 29.2%, op margin 15.8% versus 27.3%; PAT fell 16.2% despite revenue +27.6%.
Reported PAT is noisy: FY2025 included ₹15,583.12cr demerger gain; 2025-03-31 PAT ₹19,727.37cr was followed by 2026-03-31 PAT -72.7% YoY.
Segment revenue shares and geographic breakdown are not stated, so concentration across cigarettes, foods, paperboards and agri cannot be quantified from the dossier.

watch: Whether EBITDA/op margins recover from 17.3%/15.8% toward prior 29-31% levels.
Whether revenue growth above 20% sustains while PAT stops declining.
Any disclosure of segment shares, geographic mix, or demerger-adjusted comparables.
